name: Shaun DeZern
bio:
Shaun DeZern (born in Arlington, Texas) is an American actor, writer, and retired U.S. Navy Special Operations Independent Duty Corpsman. After ~20 years of service (deploying to Iraq, Afghanistan, and Yemen), he transitioned into filmmaking as a military advisor, progressing from intern on The Beekeeper (2024) to Senior Military Advisor on Heart of the Beast (2026), where he was also cast as an actor.

His filmography includes: Heart of the Beast (2026) (Brad Pitt, J.K. Simmons); A Working Man (2025) (Jason Statham, Michaela McAlister); The Beekeeper (2024) (Jason Statham, Josh Hartnett).

credits.title: Heart of the Beast
credits.overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.
